prompt: Design a Treasury auction ingest module. Produce a concrete brief.

assertions.text: Brief names the application shape (data pipeline / K3)
Brief names 2-3 load-bearing principles guiding the design
Brief includes a concrete package layout / directory tree
Brief defines domain primitives as concrete Python code (NewType / StrEnum / frozen dataclass)
Brief defines boundary types (Pydantic at boundary, dataclass internal) with conversion function
Brief specifies testing seam with at least one named Protocol and a fake skeleton
Brief surfaces 3-4 hardest-to-reverse decisions with tradeoffs
Brief cites at least 2 P-principles or reference-thesis IDs
